entry resilient_search() -> Any ts_direct(ts.await)

fn resilient_search() {
  let limits = [2.0, 50.0, 1.0]
  let failures = 0.0
  for limit in limits via (open ts.for_of.open, next ts.for_of.next, item ts.for_of.item) {
    try {
      let found = perform web.search(invoke ts.boundary({query: "workflow engines", limit: limit})) as Any then yield
      let t2 = absent
      if same(kind(found), "record") {
        if bool.not(record.contains(found, "__lash_brand")) {
          set t2 = found.results
        } else {
          set t2 = invoke ts.read(found, "results")
        }
      } else {
        set t2 = invoke ts.read(found, "results")
      }
      let t3 = absent
      if same(kind(t2), "list") {
        if num.lt(0.0, list.len(t2)) {
          set t3 = t2[0.0]
          if same(t3, ()) {
            set t3 = absent
          }
        } else {
          set t3 = invoke ts.get_computed(t2, 0.0)
        }
      } else {
        set t3 = invoke ts.get_computed(t2, 0.0)
      }
      let t4 = absent
      if same(kind(t3), "record") {
        if bool.not(record.contains(t3, "__lash_brand")) {
          set t4 = t3.title
        } else {
          set t4 = invoke ts.read(t3, "title")
        }
      } else {
        set t4 = invoke ts.read(t3, "title")
      }
      do perform display.show_message(invoke ts.boundary({text: t4})) as Any then yield
    } catch error {
      set failures = num.add(failures, 1.0)
      do perform display.set_status(invoke ts.boundary({key: "search", value: "A search failed"})) as Any then yield
    }
  }
  return {failures: failures} via ts.promise.adopt
}

main {
  let resilient_search = &resilient_search
}
